primary_title: Extracellular vesicles released by transforming growth factor-beta 1-preconditional mesenchymal stem cells promote recovery in mice with spinal cord injury
decision_basis: The primary study reports increased mTORC2/Rictor pathway-associated proteins after TGF-beta1-preconditioned MSC EV treatment and reduced EV efficacy in Rictor-deficient neural stem cells.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the preconditioned EV formulation, endogenous-NSC and Rictor-conditional-knockout context; this is perturbation-supported pathway association, not proof of a specific EV cargo or receptor.

primary_title: Extracellular vesicles released by transforming growth factor-beta 1-preconditional mesenchymal stem cells promote recovery in mice with spinal cord injury
decision_basis: The primary study reports that TGF-beta1-preconditioned MSC EVs increase the shift from M1 toward M2 polarization of reactive microglia after spinal cord injury.
limitations_preserved: Preserve the preconditioned EV formulation and mouse SCI context; M1/M2 are marker-defined states and no universal microglial identity or terminal TF is assigned.
